user.title: Axonometra
user.description: Adds a sidebar page where you draw your home and see it in 3D.

ask.name: Ask the house
ask.description: Hands a sentence to the open Axonometra views: "Show the living room" shows it, questions are answered by the installed modules ("What is open?"). The first view that understands answers.

text.name: Sentence
text.description: What to show or ask, as you would say it.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: Only the view with this screen name reacts (set in the view's settings or the card's option screen). Empty: every open view.

speak.name: Speak
speak.description: The view speaks its answer with Assist's text-to-speech (off: it only shows it).
